text: I went in with a bunch of tooth problems. The dentists have good technique and are quite professional. The wisdom tooth extractions were superb! As someone with dentophobia/odontophobia the procedure was smooth and relatively pain-free. The prices were moderate. If you are getting a wisdom tooth extracted I suggest avoiding caffeinated beverages, except light tea, for a week and going for high protein warmed ice cream without bits, eggs, bland lukewarm soups, soft pancakes, mashed potatoes etc. Avoid straws. Speeds up recovery. Lukewarm salt water gargles really help. Reception people could improve soft-skills. The place is located near Exit 1 from Phahonyothin 24 station or walking distance from Central Latphrao. Nearest MRT is BL14. Thank you!
